paragraphs: R' Pinhas the priest, in the midrashim. Perhaps he is the aforementioned bar Hama. It is puzzling that Yuhasin did not mention that Pinhas bar Hama was a priest. Under the letter shin he wrote, ‘Shmuel, brother of Pinham the priest, bar Hama.’ End quotation.
